title: Memory and tone of voice
summary: Tell Parachute once how you like your work written, and it applies that across chat, emails and documents.
body_markdown:
Tell Parachute once that you sign off with “Kind regards” or prefer short paragraphs, and you no longer need to repeat it in every prompt.


## Memory


- Add a preference under Settings > Memory, or state one in chat. Parachute saves it and shows a notice, so nothing is remembered silently.
- Your preferences apply across chat, email drafting and documents.
- See, edit or delete any memory at any time. Two switches let you turn memory off, or stop it saving from chat.
- Memory holds preferences only. It never saves client or matter information, and your memories are yours, not shared with your firm.


## Tone of voice


Email replies come in up to three tones, shown as tabs on the draft. Rename them, rewrite how each should sound, or add your own. Set your sign-off, greeting and document voice once under Settings > Tone of voice, and every draft follows them.


[Read more about memory](https://help.goparachute.ai/features/memory/)
